problemItems: Documentation gets outdated the moment you ship.
Ideas disappear into notes you never reopen.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Hilm is designed so your operating system stays yours.
privacy.p1: Account data, projects, and AI conversation history are stored in your Supabase project under row-level security. AI requests use Hilm’s OpenRouter key on the server — never shipped in the client bundle.
privacy.p2: Offline caches live on your device via IndexedDB and the service worker. You can request export of your data from Settings as that surface ships.
